description: This Java source file defines the JmsListenerFactory class, which manages the creation, loading, refreshing, and closing of JMS message listeners within the Apache OFBiz framework. It handles dynamic loading of listener classes, maintains listener instances, and runs a background thread to initialize and monitor JMS listeners based on configuration.

classes.name: JmsListenerFactory
classes.description: A factory class responsible for managing JMS listeners, including loading, refreshing, and closing them, running in a dedicated thread.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Singleton accessor for JmsListenerFactory, ensuring only one instance exists.

methods.name: JmsListenerFactory
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the factory and starts its background thread.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Main thread loop that loads JMS listeners and waits, until all are connected or no more loadable listeners remain.

methods.name: loadListeners
methods.description: Loads JMS services and initializes listeners based on configuration.

methods.name: loadListener
methods.description: Dynamically loads and instantiates a JMS listener class based on server configuration.

methods.name: loadListener (public)
methods.description: Loads a listener given its server key, using stored server configuration.

methods.name: closeListener
methods.description: Closes a specific JMS listener identified by server key.

methods.name: getJMSListeners
methods.description: Returns a map of current JMS listeners.
